Container.Name: Dipolar Server
Container.Overview: Dipolar API server. Pulls from GitHub Container Registry (ghcr.io). Uses Host network—listens on port 3333 on the Unraid host. Add the Dipolar App container after this.
Container.Description: API backend for Dipolar (Streamio IPTV). Image is published to ghcr.io—no local build needed. Uses Host network so the API is at Unraid-IP:3333. The Dipolar App container connects to it via host.docker.internal:3333. Create Dipolar Server first, then Dipolar App.

Config.Name: Catalog Data
Config.Description: Persistent catalog (channels/VOD). Mount so catalog survives container restart.
